title: Bildungsstandards-Shard (BiSt Anl. 1, BGBl. II Nr. 1/2009, NOR40255561)
description: One shard per Fach x Programmstufe at plugin/data/bildungsstandards/<shard>.json (shard in {d4,m4,d8,e8,m8}, plan Executive Summary / FINDINGS.md V-13). Descriptors are extracted from the RIS BiSt text only -- no IQS numbering, graphics or presentations (CLAUDE.md project constraint); every id is minted fresh under the AT.BIST namespace (data-pipeline/schema/bist_id_schema.py), a separate grammar from the frozen AT.LP23 Lehrplan scheme -- the two never collide by construction (different second segment: BIST vs LP23). additionalProperties is left open (true) throughout, mirroring kompetenzen.schema.json's E3-01 rationale: an unexpected but tolerable field must never turn into a hard schema-validation failure. The only hard failures are a missing id/text on a descriptor and an ID collision -- both enforced in Python (parse_bildungsstandards.py), not here.

shard.description: The plan/FINDINGS shorthand (FINDINGS.md V-13). Closed by design -- exactly the five shards in scope; a sixth would mean the parser started reading a subject/grade combination the project has not scoped.

name.description: The verbatim BiSt subject heading, e.g. '(Erste) Lebende Fremdsprache (Englisch)' -- note BiSt's own designation carries the '(Englisch)' suffix the Lehrplan heading omits (FINDINGS.md V-29).

programmstufe.description: The absolute Schulstufe this BiSt checkpoint targets. Deliberately not AT.LP23's relative K1..K4/SCH1..SCH4 -- BiSt's own text calls both checkpoints 'Schulstufe' verbatim (see bist_id_schema.py module docstring).

programmstufe_name.description: Verbatim source subtitle, e.g. '4. Schulstufe der Volksschule' or '8. Schulstufe der Volksschuloberstufe, der Mittelschule und der allgemeinbildenden höheren Schule'.

teil.description: e.g. '1. Teil' / '2. Teil' -- verbatim source heading.

abschnitt.description: e.g. '1. Abschnitt' / '2. Abschnitt' / '3. Abschnitt' -- verbatim source heading.

kompetenzmodell_hinweis.description: Subject-level explanatory prose preceding the first Kompetenzbereich, verbatim. Measured present only for M8 ('Das Kompetenzmodell für Mathematik auf der 8. Schulstufe legt „Inhaltsbereiche“ fest, ...'); absent for D4/M4/D8/E8, which have no such paragraph in the source.

kompetenzbereiche.description: Every official competence area for this shard, in document order: 5 for D4, 8 for M4, 4 for D8, 5 for E8, 16 for M8 (M8's 16 are the cross product of 4 Handlungsbereiche x 4 Inhaltsbereiche -- see bist_id_schema.py). Measured against the live NOR40255561.xml, 2026-08-04.

deskriptoren.description: Every BiSt descriptor (one per source bullet item, plus the rare standalone single-sentence competence that carries no bullet list at all -- see Deskriptor.text). Flat, not nested under kompetenzbereiche[] -- join via bereich_code.

provenienz.description: Read directly from the BiSt document's own RIS header/footer fields (Kurztitel, Kundmachungsorgan, ... Gesetzesnummer, Dokumentnummer) -- self-contained, not dependent on the gitignored resources/manifest.json (dokument_url/eli/stand are added best-effort from the manifest when present, and are therefore the only optional fields here; `stand` is the manifest's retrieval_date under the same field name the curriculum shards use).

kurztitel.description: Live RIS value verbatim -- 'Bildungsstandardsverordnung', one word, no hyphen (FINDINGS.md V-51).

kundmachungsorgan.description: e.g. 'BGBl. II Nr. 1/2009 zuletzt geändert durch BGBl. II Nr. 262/2023'.

stand.description: Retrieval date of the RIS source, ISO 8601. Same name as the curriculum shards' provenienz.stand, so one citation formatter serves both datasets.

code.description: ID segment, e.g. 'HOERENSPRECHEN' or (M8 only) the concatenated Handlungsbereich+Inhaltsbereich code 'DARSTELLENZAHLEN'. Own AT.BIST table (data-pipeline/schema/bist_id_schema.py), not id_schema.AREA_CODES -- cross-reuse of the same code string across shards (e.g. 'LESEN' in D4/D8/E8) is deliberate and harmless, the fach+programmstufe context always disambiguates.

name.description: Cleaned display name -- the heading minus its generic 'Kompetenzbereich: ' scaffold prefix, or (M8) the reconstructed 'Handlungsbereich – Inhaltsbereich' combination.

ueberschrift_roh.description: The complete heading exactly as printed, including any source typesetting inconsistency (e.g. one M8 heading keeps a colon after 'Handlungsbereich' that the other 15 drop; one is missing its closing „" guillemet) -- never 'corrected'.

handlungsbereich.description: M8 only: the Handlungsbereich axis label, cleanly extracted (colon/quote glitches removed only here, not in ueberschrift_roh).

inhaltsbereich.description: M8 only: the Inhaltsbereich axis label.

gruppe.description: M4 only: the subject-internal grouping label ('Allgemeine mathematische Kompetenzen' / 'Inhaltliche mathematische Kompetenzen') this area falls under.

beschreibung.description: D8 only: a verbatim area-level description sentence that precedes the first titled sub-group in the source. Absent where the source has none.

id.description: AT.BIST.<Fach>.<Programmstufe>.<Bereich>.<lfd> -- see data-pipeline/schema/bist_id_schema.py. lfd is scoped per (fach, programmstufe, bereich), not globally sequential.

titel.description: The bold sub-group heading this descriptor belongs to, verbatim (e.g. 'Verständlich erzählen und anderen verstehend zuhören'). Omitted where the source has no such sub-title -- measured: always absent for E8 and M8, which go straight from the Kompetenzbereich heading to the 'Kompetenzen:' stem.

stammsatz.description: The competence-stem sentence verbatim, with the literal 'Kompetenzen:' run-in label stripped (that word is BiSt's own section scaffolding, not part of the competence sentence -- a deliberate parallel to how AT.LP23's Kompetenz.stammsatz captures the Lehrplan stem). Both forms occur verbatim in the source and are kept as printed: 'Die Schülerinnen und Schüler können' and the shorter 'Die Schülerinnen und Schüler' (verb moved into the item text itself, e.g. '...können Situationen richtig einschätzen...'). A faithful quotation of one descriptor is stammsatz + text, exactly the AT.LP23 kompetenz.stammsatz consumer obligation.

text.description: Verbatim descriptor text -- almost always one dash-bulleted list item (trailing comma/period kept exactly as printed), but for the two measured standalone cases (no <liste> follows the stem at all, e.g. M4 Modellieren/Problemlösen) this is the remainder of that single sentence after the stem.

ordinal.description: 1-based position within (fach, programmstufe, bereich_code); matches the id's lfd segment.
